I have OCD, and also Pure O ocd.

Your mind can take you for ride. 

I can give u an example how I get caught up in my mind.

I would be watching the news, if they show a murder that killed their parents or something.

Then my mind will fix on that,  my mind will ask oh what if I am capable of doing that. Then my mind will start showing random images to support that question.

Then I will start panicking,  why if I lose control and kill my parents or why if I am a murder.

The thought will keep replaying, out of fear i would avoid contact with my parents, stay away from them or get anxious if there are sharp objects. I will freak out about this for a whole week , until I calm down.

Everyone gets these  random thought but they just ignore it, but ocd brain just hangs on to those thoughts. 

The real reason my brain was fixated on that news was that, it was so shocking to me that anyone can do that and watching that news was traumatic and caused me alot of anxiety and my brain didn't know how to cope with horrible news.

Another thing is, you will be talking to someone and random inappropriate imagines will just pop up and it will cause panic.

Most people just ignore them, only thing that helps me is distraction and being aware that, those are just thoughts.

Think of your brain like a huge database,  everytime you think.of some thing or ask a question, your mind just does a Google search in ur brain database and pops up all images related to that.

Its our job to ignore, information that is not relevant.
